title: Boostly fulfillment request ledger
description: One location's review-queue entry. Branding runners emit this; review-queue.mjs renders it into a Notion toggle. Only business, city, and account_id are required; everything else degrades to a placeholder cell.

business.description: Business name without the city suffix, e.g. "Denise's Delicacies".

city.description: City shown in parentheses in the heading.

status.description: Which H1 section the toggle belongs under.

waiting_on.description: Who or what it waits on, e.g. "Jonathan: offer + quantities". Becomes the heading label "waiting on <x>" when status is waiting.

label.description: Optional explicit heading label that overrides waiting_on / DONE.

ease.description: 1 = quickest review. Orders the queue and renders as [ease x/5].

verdict.description: One or two sentences: what the reviewer should do.

applied.description: What was written to production (scope, colors, logo, socials, events) and how it was verified.

signage.description: Sheet count, quantities, offer copy, sticker/POP logo choices.

figma_url.description: Figma section URL (In-Store-Fulfillment file, node-id of the section).

ordering_url.description: Ordering URL; used as the Website fallback and kept for the runner.

place_id.description: Google place id. Anything not shaped like a place id (e.g. "manual") renders as a Google search link instead of a Maps link.

address.description: Street address; used in the manual-place-id Google search query.

variant_sheets.description: Variant sheets (brand-design rule 2b) to embed under the toggle, one image block each. Several are allowed; when a run stitched its sheets into one variant-sheet-all.png, list that file once. ledger-from-manifest.mjs derives this from manifest.variant_sheet.

png.description: Absolute path to the sheet PNG (uploaded to Notion).

json.description: Absolute path to the variant-sheet.json whose cells[<letter>] describes the applied cell (hexes, row label, logo, badge digit).

label.description: Caption label; defaults to the PNG basename. Also the key used to find an existing image block on upsert.

applied_letter.description: The lettered cell that went to production, e.g. "Q".

applied_variant.description: Free-text override for the Variant row, e.g. "Q (#8D4CED / #6416D7, white digit)". When set it replaces the text derived from the sheet json.
